messages:
PagerBot: INCIDENT 6152 — detected: increased 5xx rate from eu-west-1 serving cluster (spike starting 4865001200). auto-triage score: medium. paging eng-oncall primary.
Maya K: seeing the spike on dashboards, started reducing batch size for endpoints to shed load. latency up ~40% for long requests. attaching perf graph in #incidents.
Carlos R: I'm on inbound for the 18:00->02:00 shift, standing by to take over.
Maya K: handing off — primary for evening. Current state: partial degradation, not full outage. Customers in EU seeing increased tail lat. I've scaled the control-plane pool +1 but not effective yet.
Carlos R: thanks — quick note on responsibilities: I'll keep primary for alerting/triage, Maya will stay on as secondary for context unless you need to disengage.
Maya K: agreed. I've put the incident severity as SEV-2 provisional; we should keep customers informed if this persists >15m.
Priya S: infra note — telemetry shows higher GPU OOM retry rates on a particular host set (nodegroup-eu-3). I'm running node diagnostics now. Could be a kernel issue causing retries.
Carlos R: ok Priya, if nodegroup-eu-3 is unhealthy, can we cordon and redirect traffic to eu-west-2? What's the rollback time?
Priya S: estimated failover time ~6-8 minutes if we initiate region routing policy (we'll need approval to increase cross-region egress).
Maya K: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/serving/eu-deg (private). quick snippet from runbook for failover:
```
1) set routing.override_region=eu-west-2 via control plane
2) scale consumers in eu-west-2 +2 nodes
3) enable prefix-caching for prod routes
4) monitor 5xx and latency for 10m
```
Carlos R: decision: we should try a targeted cordon of the unhealthy nodegroup first to avoid cross-region traffic. If retries continue after 10m, we escalate to full region failover.
Arman L: I'm SRE lead on-call for the evening. If you plan cross-region failover, page me immediately and I'll coordinate with network (we'll need a change ticket for egress).
Carlos R: noted. Maya — can you confirm cordon/evict steps? Also open an incident in PagerDuty for visibility?
Maya K: cordoning now. `kubectl cordon nodegroup-eu-3-*` then drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. evictions in progress (10 pods moved).
SupportBot: Customer impact classifier updated to "partial degradation - EU only". Notifying support_escalations@redwood.com.
Jen T: Support here — prepping a short customer-facing blurb outlining degraded performance for EU customers, ETA for next update 20m. Share with me before posting.
Carlos R: observed some recovery signals on a subset of endpoints — 5xx decreased by 30% after cordon. Good sign. Keep monitoring for 10m.
Priya S: kernel panic rates persisted on 2 hosts, opened a hardware ticket. I'm provisioning replacements just in case.
Maya K: passing the on-call baton to Carlos now (per our shift guideline). Carlos, you're primary. My checklist: incident channel updated, runbook followed -> cordon attempted, support loop opened. I'll remain available as secondary until 4865002000.
Carlos R: taking primary. Quick runbook pointer for whoever picks this up later: if failover is initiated, mark runbook step: `failover-approval: arman.accepted` in the incident doc, and then run `scripts/route_override --region eu-west-2 --commit`.
Arman L: if you escalate to failover, I'll mobilize network and sign-off on change ticket. Also, page product-ops if the customer-blurb needs approval faster than 30m.
Carlos R: escalation rules we're following now (documenting here for oncall handover):
- Page primary on any SEV >= 2 auto-alerts (PagerBot did).
- If mitigation (cordon / soft fixes) not effective in 10m -> page infra lead (Priya) and SRE lead (Arman) by phone.
- If cross-region failover is needed -> page CTO/exec on-call and product-ops for customer comms.
Maya K: adding: if customer error-rate increases >50% or more than 10% of traffic is failing, escalate immediately to Arman and initiate failover steps.
Carlos R: adding on-call contact plan: first page: eng-oncall primary (this channel) -> 5m wait -> if no resolution, page infra (Priya S) -> 10m wait -> call SRE lead (Arman L) -> 15m wait -> call exec on-call. Phone numbers stored in the oncall rota doc.
OpsRotation: noted handoff in rotas: primary now Carlos R until 02:00. Secondary Maya K until 22:00.
Jen T: got the blurb, posting after minor edits — will post to status.redwood.ai and notify top 10 impacted customers.
Carlos R: status update for incident doc: cordon ran, 5xx down 30%, monitoring for 10m window. Next update @4865001380.
PagerBot: update received. Incident 6152 state: "mitigating". Next automated check in 5m.
Maya K: thanks team. I'll stay on the thread for any deep-dive. If things regress, Carlos — feel free to escalate to Arman ASAP. :thumbsup:
Carlos R: thanks — will update when window completes or earlier if things change.
